d.t: JOINER FOR WALL EXTENDER FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOF PLANTING TRAY
d.s: SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Joiner is a joiner for wall extenders designed to allow wall extenders to be joined side to side, creating a single perimeter wall around the extensive green roof plot. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into two adjacent wall extenders to connect them. SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Joiner is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender and SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Increased planting media capacity for extensive green roofs, landscape decks and lightweight green installations requiring water storage in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the reservoir and drainage layer.
